quote: The EXIM Board of Directors unanimously approved a transaction where the borrower and end-user of a $69.8 million direct loan is Hokchi Energy S.A. de C.V. of Mexico, with Pan American Energy S.L. of Argentina acting as guarantor. Hokchi Energy will use the direct loan for the purchase of U.S. goods and services including turbines, compressor units, and spare parts, for use in the production and processing of oil and gas resources located in an offshore block in the Gulf of Mexico.
note: Opened EXIM.gov press page 2026-10-04; FY2021 Annual Report confirms authorization year.
